F_RexFleetAcademy.text: Rex Fleet Academy: young pilots, navigators, technicians, engineers, and junior officers are taught to distinguish doctrine from measurement and to understand why post-Shattering operating rules exist.

F_BHA.text: BHA corridor-verification infrastructure: public beacons default red when a segment is unsafe or its sensors cannot verify the low-tension state; green means the surrounding travel volume has been verified, not that the beacon itself creates the corridor.
